name: Kettlebell Double Overhead Press
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two kettlebells in the front rack position with your elbows tucked in and wrists neutral.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes and quads tightly to create a solid base.
Press both kettlebells smoothly overhead in a slight arc until your arms are locked straight with your biceps beside your ears.
Lower both bells under control back into the front rack position.
tips: Do not dip your knees or lean your torso backward to force the weights overhead.
Keep your forearms vertical underneath the handles as you initiate the press.
